text:
olivia: starting change window for conversation-service v3.0.2 -> prod. plan: 12% for 12m -> 45% for 12m. gating on regional p95, global 5xx, and network error spikes. kicking off 12% canary now. pls watch nets and slo dashboards and raise flags.

deploy-bot: rollout started by olivia. env=prod, version=v3.0.2. steps=[12%:12m,45%:12m]. auto-rollback thresholds: regional p95>700ms or global 5xx>0.5% sustained 3m. annotating change window.

slo-bot: baseline snapshot: global p95=180ms, current p95(5m)=185ms; 5xx baseline=0.04%, current=0.05%. no hard alarms yet. will post deltas at 6m.

zack: seeing transient DNS lookup failures in eu-west region aligning with canary shift, ~0.2% of requests got SERVFAIL. tracing shows short retry storms.

network-bot: network alert: edge-dns-eu west saw short RRSIG validation stalls at 2026-03-22T11:10:12Z causing ~30s lookup latency for a subset of clients. rate=0.18% for 2m window.

priya: application-side retries are amplifying the DNS blips causing concurrent request bursts to backend pods, which creates short p95 spikes on /converse.

olivia: ok hold ramp. keep at 12%. slo-bot please run a quick before/after delta for eu-west and global, and list top affected routes. also can we pin the 12% away from eu-west temporarily while we investigate?

slo-bot: delta(10m pre vs 5m post): eu-west /converse p95 +210ms, global p95 +45ms, 5xx eu-west +0.22%. Top nodes impacted: pod-conv-eu-3, pod-conv-eu-5. Recommendation: temporarily divert canary traffic away from eu-west region OR apply client-side retry backoff throttle.

network-bot: DNS provider reports partial zone validation lag. mitigation in flight: failover to secondary resolver for canary traffic and increase client retry backoff. ETA for resolver failover config push: 90s.

zack: prefer diverting the canary 12% to us/asia regions for now to avoid cross-region noise while infra trades with provider. we can route only the canary subset.

olivia: decision: divert the 12% canary away from eu-west to us/asia (split 60/40) and annotate change window: "diverted canary away from eu-west due to DNS validation stalls; holding ramp". deploy-bot, apply pin and routing change and link incident ticket.

deploy-bot: actioned: traffic for v3.0.2 canary rerouted: eu-west excluded; 12% diverted to us/asia (60/40). rollout paused by olivia. traffic pinned away from eu-west. Incident created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-4201. auto-rollback still armed.

slo-bot: post-diversion check (3m): eu-west p95 returning to baseline in 4m window; global 5xx down to 0.046%. no hard SLO breach. continuing monitor for 15m.

priya: filing follow-up infra ticket to add retry jitter and client-side exponential backoff for conversation clients to reduce amplification: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4380.

olivia: thanks all. i'll update release notes: "paused ramp due to external DNS validation stalls causing localized eu-west p95/5xx bump; diverted canary away from eu-west and applied failover; follow-ups: add retry backoff + DNS provider escalation." sync in 20m. :white_check_mark:
